title: Songpyeon-Infused French Cranberry Crumble
description: A sweet and tangy dessert combining the flavors of France and Korea. Crunchy oat topping with a hint of sesame seeds complements the sweet songpyeon and cranberry filling.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together songpyeon, cranberries, granulated sugar, and flour.
Transfer the mixture into a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In another bowl, mix together butter and sesame seeds.
Add the butter mixture to the dry ingredients (rolled oats and salt) and mix until crumbly.
Spread the crumb mixture evenly over the filling.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
